# S4.10 — C1 Read-Only Web Instrument over Binding (c)

## Summary

Lands the C1 read-only web instrument (`R-2.11.2¹`): the `hh-web`
surface serving V1 (run browser), V2 (trace), V3-scrub (time-travel
only), V5-monitor, V6 scorecard/comparison, V7 leaderboard, V8 approval
inbox, V9 audit, V10 registry, and V11-run over **binding (c)
`local_network`** — JSON-RPC over loopback HTTP under the WS-H3/K2
bearer scheme and the full P1–P9 / AC-6a–i security battery (not
deferred). Every view is a pure, store-free projection; every
browser-visible byte either replays a canonical kernel result verbatim
or renders `n/a{reason}`; every consequential write goes through the
named kernel op set and nothing else reaches the dispatcher.

- **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.9` (stacked, @ cd11618)
- **Requirement:** R-2.11.2¹ (§7.2)
- **ADRs owned:** ADR-0301 (binding-(c) rulings), ADR-0302 (surface
  rulings)
- **Layers:** C1 (`hh-web` surface + `hh-embed::net` binding (c))
- **Gate:** operator-authorized — hermetic/offline web instrument +
  security battery; HUMAN-H1 (E3 surface-ecosystem binding) records
  DEFERRALS row DF-S4.10-1 and reports "gate pending", never a failure
- **Live stage:** offline-only (loopback fixtures, no egress, no spend)

## What changed

### `crates/hh-wire` — shared HTTP/1.1 codec (new `http.rs`)

One wire-shape implementation (CC1): bounded request/response head
parse (`MAX_HEAD_BYTES`/`MAX_HEADERS`), `Content-Length` bodies only —
no chunked encoding, trailers, pipelining, keep-alive reuse, or 1xx;
typed `HttpError` refusals. Shared by the binding-(c) server,
`NetClient`, and `hh-web`.

### Binding (c) `local_network` — `crates/hh-embed/src/net.rs`

- `serve_net`/`serve_net_n`: `POST /hh-embed/1` = one canonical JSON-RPC
  request → one canonical response through the *same* `EmbedService::
  handle` — byte-identical envelopes with binding (a)
  (`net_post_parity_with_handle`); `GET /hh-embed/1/events[?wait_ms=]`
  drains notifications as NDJSON (`Connection: close` always).
- Gate (pre-dispatch, fail-closed): loopback-only bind refusal; exact
  `Host` match; `Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-*` presence → 403; `?token=` → 400;
  `Authorization: Bearer` required, constant-time compare.
- WS-H3/K2 token: per-launch ≥128-bit mint, delivered via
  `--token-file` (mode 600) / `--token` / one stderr line on
  `hh-kernel serve --http` (OQ-389 interim delivery; ADR-0301 D4).

### Schema + generated client (single source — CC7)

- `OpenSessionParams.client{kind, sink?, surface_ref?, ui_caps?}`;
  `RespondPermissionParams.responder{subject_ref, surface_session_ref}`;
  new Group-R session-free op `run_index` (V1's store-level index).
- `hh-codegen` regenerated `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json` +
  `generated.rs`; `NetClient` in `hh-embed-client-generated` speaks
  binding (c) byte-for-byte with the same hello contract checks —
  it is the declared HUMAN-H1 proxy and carries the real transport.

### `crates/hh-ledger` / `crates/hh-embed` / `crates/hh-kernel`

- `Store::run_index(filter, cursor, limit)` — per-run manifest +
  tail-event fold, result-bounded pages.
- `open_session{client}` lands durable
  `lifecycle.session.attached/detached{binding: local_network,
  client{kind: web}}` via `commit_kernel_row_for` (attach sessions hold
  no lease); `measurement.export.delivered{sink: surface:<session>,
  view_kind, seq_range, content_classes}` minted on content-class
  servings to `client.kind == "web"` sessions (audit-inclusion
  accounting); `responder` provenance partition on
  `security.permission.decided`; owner-projected view kinds
  (`trace_view`, `cost_view`, `effect_ledger`, `branch_tree`) folded at
  the boundary per ADR-0042 D2.
- `hh-kernel serve --http <addr> [--token-file|--token]` — binding (c)
  on the real kernel.

### `crates/hh-web` (new crate + `hh-web` binary)

- `gate` — P1–P9 posture: exact Host, constant-time bearer, Origin
  allow-list, `Sec-Fetch-*` refusal, mutating-route fetch-metadata +
  script-header requirement, query-token refusal, off-loopback bind
  refusal, hardening/framing headers; a refused request never reaches
  dispatch (`e2e_gate_refusal_never_dispatches`).
- `server` — serial listener: `GET /` shell + `/app.js`/`/app.css`
  (public, no-token), `POST /api` forwarding with session/provenance
  injection, `GET /events` NDJSON relay (live-only, never persisted).
- `session` — lazy `hello` (`capabilities.experimental` opt-in for
  `list_leases`), per-run attach sessions `client{kind: web}`, writer
  sessions for `respond_permission`/`amend`/`kernel.reproduce`;
  reconnect = replay-from-cursor + dedupe by seq.
- `sink` — declared `SinkPolicy`; out-of-policy content classes are
  withheld, never served.
- `views` — V1–V11 view-model shaping: pure selection/labelling, no
  recompute; `n/a{reason}` verbatim; scorecard/comparison cells
  record-faithful; context-view hash parity; R-D-1…8 headers
  (`report_id`/`view_hash`), badges, deep links; the C1 op allow-list
  is closed — everything else answers `Refused{op_not_admitted}` at
  the surface gate before any kernel contact.
- `ui`/`main` — static shell (presentation only) + the `hh-web`
  binary (`--kernel`, `--token-file`, `--canary`, `--trusted-origins`,
  `--sink`, `--subject`).

## Deviations / decisions

- Serial `serve_net` (`EmbedService` is not `Send`/`Sync`); `serve_net_n`
  drives tests with the client on a spawned thread — ADR-0301 D9.
- `run_index` is session-free under the `lab.results.*` precedent —
  ADR-0301 D5.
- `capabilities.experimental: true` declared at the surface hello so
  V11's `list_leases` resolves (opt-in is the declared mechanism; the op
  admission table stays closed).
- Stub-kernel fixtures retained only for gate/op-admission legs; real
  `EmbedService` coverage lands via `serve_net_n` for the declaration
  and session-bearing paths (three stub-masked bugs — strict-decode
  `surface_ref`/`ui_caps`, `view`→`view_kind`, experimental opt-in —
  were caught and fixed against the real kernel; gap table in
  `runs/S4.10.md`).

## Deferred

- **DF-S4.10-1 (P)** — HUMAN-H1 E3 surface-ecosystem binding:
  operator work outside this gate's scope; the in-tree generated
  `NetClient` is the declared proxy carrying the real transport.
  Status: OPEN — "gate pending" per the manifest rule, never a failure.
